node_root.text: Keep your hands where I can see them, Drifter. Word in the gutter is you know how to bypass OmniCorp quantum locks without triggering a retinal burn. I've got a vault in the Sub-Grid with our names on it.

choices.text: [Mind Check - Hard] Scan his retinal cyberware for an active OmniCorp bounty tracker.
[EtherTech Check - Moderate] Attune to the ether vibration around his briefcase.
[Presence Check - Moderate] "Cut the sales pitch, Rourke. Double the advance or I walk."
"I'm listening. What's the target and what's my cut?"
"Not interested in Syndicate heat. Walk away."

node_mind_success.text: Rourke flinches as your neural deck silently queries his optic node. He smiles coldly. 'Sharp eye. Yes, OmniCorp has a kill squad in the sector. That's why we need this data siphon before midnight.'

choices.text: "Then we work on my terms. Send the coordinates."

node_ether_success.text: The air chills as your ether aura connects. You sense the raw violet hum of an unstable Ether Relic sealed in his case. 'You felt that, didn't you? It's not just data. It's a technomantic conduit.'

choices.text: "An unshielded conduit is dangerous. I'll need hazard compensation."

node_presence_success.text: Rourke's jaw tightens, but he taps his cred-chip. 'Fine. 2,000 credits upon delivery. But if you blow the stealth protocol, your bounty goes public.'

choices.text: "Deal. Brief me on the vault security."

node_details.text: Target is Sub-Grid Vault 09. Security consists of automated laser grids, two OmniCorp sentries, and an encrypted central console. Hack the terminal or neutralize the guards.
